mapper.select:
SELECT PAGE.MENU_NO AS PAGE_NO, PAGE.MENU_NAME AS PAGE_NAME, IFNULL(PAGE.VISIBLE_ORDER,0) AS PAGE_ORDER_NO, PAGE.SITE_NAME, PAGE_GROUP.MENU_NO AS PAGE_GRP_NO, PAGE_GROUP.MENU_NAME AS PAGE_GRP_NAME, IFNULL(PAGE_GROUP.VISIBLE_ORDER,00) AS PAGE_GRP_ODER_NO, MENU.MENU_NO AS MENU_NO, MENU.USR_MENU_NAME AS MENU_NAME, MENU.GUID AS GUID, MENU.MENU_AUTH AS MENU_AUTH, IFNULL(MENU.VISIBLE_ORDER,0) AS PAGE_MENU_ORDER_NO, PAGE.WEB_ICON_CLASS, MENU.GRP_TYPE, MENU.SCOND_USE, MENU.RT_USE, IF(MENU.MENU_TYPE IS NOT NULL, MENU.MENU_TYPE, MENU.USR_MENU_TYPE) AS MENU_TYPE, MENU.LINK_VIEW_TYPE FROM COM_MENU PAGE, COM_MENU PAGE_GROUP, ( SELECT A1.*, IFNULL(B1.MENU_NM, A1.MENU_NAME) AS USR_MENU_NAME, C1.GRP_TYPE, C1.SCOND_USE, C1.RT_USE, IF(NULLIF(C1.GUID, '') IS NULL, A1.MENU_TYPE, 'LAYOUT') AS USR_MENU_TYPE FROM COM_MENU A1 LEFT OUTER JOIN CM_CFG_LAYOUT_VIEW_ENV B1 ON (A1.GUID = B1.VIEW_KIND AND B1.USER_ID = #{userId}) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT GUID, MENU_NAME, GRP_TYPE, SCOND_USE, RT_USE FROM COM_MENU_LAYOUT UNION ALL SELECT GUID, MENU_NAME, 'NONE' as GRP_TYPE, SCOND_USE, 0 AS RT_USE FROM COM_MENU_WIDGET ) C1 ON (A1.GUID = C1.GUID) ) MENU WHERE PAGE.MENU_KIND = 'PAGE' AND PAGE_GROUP.MENU_KIND = 'PAGE_GROUP' AND MENU.MENU_KIND = 'MENU' AND PAGE.MENU_NO = PAGE_GROUP.MENU_PAGE_NO AND PAGE.MENU_NO = MENU.MENU_PAGE_NO AND PAGE_GROUP.MENU_NO = MENU.MENU_PAGE_GRP_NO AND PAGE.SITE_NAME = PAGE_GROUP.SITE_NAME AND PAGE.SITE_NAME = MENU.SITE_NAME AND PAGE.SITE_NAME = #{siteName} AND MENU.IS_WEBUSE = 1
AND MENU.MENU_NO IN ( SELECT REL_KEY_NO FROM CM_AUTH_MENU_REL WHERE AUTH_NO = IF(#{menuAuthNo}=0, IF(#{auth}='Admin',1,IF(#{auth}='MUser',2,IF(#{auth}='User',3, 0))),#{menuAuthNo}) )
ORDER BY PAGE_ORDER_NO, PAGE_GRP_ODER_NO, PAGE_MENU_ORDER_NO

SELECT A.MENU_KIND AS MENU_TYPE, A.MENU_NO, CASE WHEN A.MENU_KIND = 'MENU' THEN MENU_PAGE_GRP_NO WHEN A.MENU_KIND = 'PAGE_GROUP' THEN MENU_PAGE_NO END AS PAGE_GRP_NO, A.MENU_NAME, A.GUID FROM COM_MENU A WHERE SITE_NAME = #{siteName} AND ((IS_WEBUSE = 1 AND MENU_KIND = 'MENU') OR MENU_KIND != 'MENU')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM COM_MENU_LAYOUT B WHERE A.GUID = B.GUID)
ORDER BY VISIBLE_ORDER ASC

select A.MENU_NO as menuNo, IFNULL(menuCnt, 0) as menuCnt from ( SELECT MENU_KIND AS MENU_TYPE, MENU_NO, CASE WHEN MENU_KIND = 'MENU' THEN MENU_PAGE_GRP_NO WHEN MENU_KIND = 'PAGE_GROUP' THEN MENU_PAGE_NO END AS PAGE_GRP_NO, MENU_NAME FROM COM_MENU WHERE SITE_NAME = #{siteName} AND ((IS_WEBUSE = 1 AND MENU_KIND = 'MENU') OR MENU_KIND != 'MENU') and menu_kind = 'PAGE_GROUP' ORDER BY VISIBLE_ORDER ASC ) A left JOIN (
SELECT PAGE_GRP_NO AS pageGrpNo, COUNT(MENU_NO) AS menuCnt FROM ( SELECT MENU_KIND AS MENU_TYPE, MENU_NO, CASE WHEN MENU_KIND = 'MENU' THEN MENU_PAGE_GRP_NO WHEN MENU_KIND = 'PAGE_GROUP' THEN MENU_PAGE_NO END AS PAGE_GRP_NO, MENU_NAME FROM COM_MENU WHERE SITE_NAME = #{siteName} AND ((IS_WEBUSE = 1 AND MENU_KIND = 'MENU') OR MENU_KIND != 'MENU') ORDER BY VISIBLE_ORDER ASC ) A WHERE MENU_TYPE = 'MENU' GROUP BY PAGE_GRP_NO ) B on A.MENU_NO = B.pageGrpNo where menuCnt is NULL

SELECT C.PAGE_GRP_NO AS pageGrpNo, SUM(menuCnt) AS menuCnt FROM ( select A.*, IFNULL(B.menuCnt, 0) AS menuCnt FROM ( SELECT MENU_KIND AS MENU_TYPE, MENU_NO, CASE WHEN MENU_KIND = 'MENU' THEN MENU_PAGE_GRP_NO WHEN MENU_KIND = 'PAGE_GROUP' THEN MENU_PAGE_NO END AS PAGE_GRP_NO, MENU_NAME FROM COM_MENU WHERE SITE_NAME = #{siteName} AND ((IS_WEBUSE = 1 AND MENU_KIND = 'MENU') OR MENU_KIND != 'MENU') ) A left join ( select PAGE_GRP_NO, COUNT(MENU_NO) as menuCnt from (
SELECT MENU_KIND AS MENU_TYPE, MENU_NO, CASE WHEN MENU_KIND = 'MENU' THEN MENU_PAGE_GRP_NO WHEN MENU_KIND = 'PAGE_GROUP' THEN MENU_PAGE_NO END AS PAGE_GRP_NO, MENU_NAME FROM COM_MENU WHERE SITE_NAME = #{siteName} AND ((IS_WEBUSE = 1 AND MENU_KIND = 'MENU') OR MENU_KIND != 'MENU') ) A where A.MENU_TYPE = 'MENU' group by PAGE_GRP_NO ) B on A.menu_no = B.PAGE_GRP_NO where A.menu_type != 'MENU' ) c WHERE menu_type = 'PAGE_GROUP' GROUP BY C.PAGE_GRP_NO HAVING SUM(menuCnt) = 0

SELECT A.MENU_NAME, A.GUID, A.GRP_TYPE, A.SCOND_USE, IF(B.GUID IS NULL, 0, 1) IS_REG_MENU FROM COM_MENU_LAYOUT A LEFT JOIN COM_MENU B ON (A.GUID = B.GUID AND B.MENU_KIND = 'MENU' AND B.SITE_NAME = #{siteName})

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM COM_MENU A, CM_AUTH_MENU_REL B, COM_USER C WHERE A.MENU_KIND = 'MENU' AND A.MENU_NO = B.REL_KEY_NO AND B.AUTH_NO = IFNULL(C.MENU_AUTH_NO, IF(C.AUTH='Admin', 1, IF(C.AUTH='MUser', 2, 3))) AND C.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.GUID = #{guid}
select MENU_NO from COM_MENU where GUID='BB590E9A-A453-4F8A-B1D8-737A4D07BDD0' limit 1

WITH parentMenu AS ( SELECT * FROM com_menu WHERE menu_kind IN ('PAGE', 'PAGE_GROUP') ) SELECT (SELECT menu_name FROM parentMenu pm WHERE pm.menu_no = m.menu_page_no) AS menu_page_name, (SELECT menu_name FROM parentMenu pm WHERE pm.menu_no = m.menu_page_grp_no ) AS menu_grp_name, m.menu_name FROM com_menu m WHERE guid = #{guid}
